Rae (CS): Quick alert 10  Renewal coming up 2026-06-30. Recent telemetry: embeddings -58% MoM, gen tokens -49%, active seats 21 -> 8. Champion moved teams. We need a tight triage and a short playbook.

Noel (CSM): Yikes. Any competitor signal or infra problems?

Rae (CS): Procurement pinged: they're running a 7-day spike with EchoSummit starting yesterday. No errors on our side.

Hannah (RevOps): Billing confirms the drop. I can draft a POC concession: 20% off embeddings during trial + $7k enablement credit if they convert in 30 days. Need finance OK.

Vik (Eng): I'll prepare a reproducible bake-off harness (700-doc set) with deterministic prompts and metrics: precision@5, avg cosine gap, and 95th pct latency. Will push to /shared/zenhealth/bakeoff.

Luis (Support): One inbound ticket says "other vendor cheaper for embeddings". Asked for their sample docs.

Noel (CSM): Proposed actions: (1) Offer 8-day Dedicated-lite POC; (2) run blind bake-off with objective metrics; (3) prepare a short technical walk-through for new stakeholders. I'll own outreach.

Vik (Eng): Repro snippet I will include:
```
python bench/runner.py --data zen_700.json --model rwd-embed-compact --batch 128
```
I'll attach perf numbers and deterministic seeds.

trial-bot: Dedicated-lite instance zenhealth-poc-01 provisioned (expires in 8 days).

Rae (CS): Noel, please invite new stakeholders: Sam (Head of Data) and Lila (Procurement). Suggest Tue 10am PT. Include success metrics: precision@5 >= 0.75, 95th pct latency <= 140ms.

Noel (CSM): Invite sent. Hannah, can you share the concession language and trial waiver?

Hannah (RevOps): Draft ready  I'll post PDF in the shared folder by EOD and loop in finance/legal.

Luis (Support): I'll standby for realtime logs and any repro during the POC.

Rae (CS): If EchoSummit matches quality but has a materially lower price, we'll propose a short retention package: one-month credit + prioritized onboarding. Hannah, prepare numbers for that scenario.

Hannah (RevOps): Will quantify and share by EOD.

Noel (CSM): Owners: Noel (outreach & invite), Vik (bench harness), Hannah (pricing & waiver), Luis (support). Reconvene after bake-off with results and next steps. :white_check_mark:
